Reviewed in the United States on June 16, 2019 Verified Purchase No spoken audio -0:00 Love this diaper bag and hip hop culture! Not only is it stylish, it is super functional for all my baby needs. First I will note that I love that the top has a bit of interior construction so it’s not floppy and it zips close - huge plus. I previously had an Eddie Bauer diaper bag and it was magnetized- never stayed close! It has compartments which is nice, also comes with a diaper changing pad. Good insulation for maintaining bottle temps, and it even comes with a port for you to charge your phone! (you just need a portable battery charger - not included). I am super happy and recommend this product. I will totally use this bag for other uses after my baby grows up. Would be a good bag to take to a festival, concert, etc. 3 people found this helpful Helpful Report MSM 5 out of 5 stars Finally! A functional diaper bag with swag.
